name: TRON

binding_cap.short_note: Capped by Regulatory Clarity Partial -- enforcement is fully resolved, but TRX is absent from the named commodity list and has no live US spot ETF.

key_findings: First chain scored with three Partial gates and no outright Pass on any TradFi gate.
On-Chain Health (88) is TRON's strongest category -- ~$2 trillion in cumulative USDT transfers in one quarter, backed by real fee revenue rather than a running subsidy.

Regulatory & Risk (48) cuts both ways on one root cause -- TRON carries a high volume of frozen/blacklisted addresses, but the entity doing that freezing was cited by FATF as a model for public-private enforcement.
No binding cap -- Deterministic Finality Partial (75) sits above the raw 67.1. TRON has no dated upgrade planned to fix its ~1 minute finality.
First chain capped on one axis and uncapped on the other by two completely unrelated gates.
Privacy & Confidentiality (53) -- TRON has live shielded transfers using zero-knowledge proofs, but adoption is unmeasured and doesn't touch the USDT flow that is effectively the entire chain.

Agent Tooling (68) -- a real, shipped agent stack (Bank of AI: payments, identity, an MCP server) launched February 2026, discounted for being six months old, single-vendor, and running on a gas subsidy.

watch_items: TRON ETF eligibility clock started July 27, 2026 with Bitnomial's CFTC-regulated TRX futures listing -- six-month generic-listing-standard milestone matures around late January 2027.

Post-quantum work (Falcon-512 and ML-DSA-44 live on Nile testnet) and the AI agent stack are both real but early -- neither contributes meaningfully to either score until proven out with mainnet activation and independent usage data.
Both axes validated in opposite directions under blind secondary review -- TradFi scores moved down, AI scores moved up.
